verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents policy creation, review and acknowledgment automation (docs-24, docs-83). It also offers an optional strict publishing workflow that requires a separate Approver's sign-off before a policy is published (docs-41), plus some HIPAA document templates (docs-85, docs-99). These cover the approvals and part of the acknowledgment and template elements, but much of the story is thin or only implied. missing for 10: evidence of a lawyer-grade policy template library, a documented in-app policy editor, policy versioning/version history, explicit per-employee acceptance tracking and reporting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
